workflows.title: Apply for leave
workflows.goal: Apply for one day of leave next Friday, with the comment 'Family event'. Pick any leave type that is available.
workflows.success_criteria: The Apply form is filled in with the date and the comment, and the Apply button is reached.

workflows.title: Find an employee's job title
workflows.goal: Open the employee list and find the first employee whose job title is shown, then open that employee's profile.
workflows.success_criteria: An employee's profile page is open.
